_meta.notes: Clerk online-system printout (summary_printer.cfm?ID=848), 5 pages. This form has NO amendment checkbox - the amendment status comes from the printed Report line, which reads 'Interim Report September 15, 2012 (Amended)'; is_amendment is recorded 'Yes' on that basis and amendment_of is left blank because the form gives no date of the amended report. Line 1's YTD cell is HANDWRITTEN and hard to read even at 900 dpi: it reads $297,594.25 but the hundreds digit is genuinely ambiguous (could be a 5) - recorded at LOW confidence, do not quote without re-checking the source. All other figures are machine-printed. report_date is the system print date in the footer (10/3/2012), later than the September 15 report it amends.

itemized.notes: NOT THE STANDARD HANDWRITTEN FORM. This filing is a Salt Lake County Clerk system printout ('Financial Disclosure Report', footer http://slcintranet/financialDisclosure/clerk/summary_printer.cfm?ID=848, printed 10/3/2012), 5 pages: p1 cover + Summary; p2-p4(top) 'Contributions Received / Itemized Contributions Received'; p4(bottom)-p5 'Expenditures Made / Itemized Expenditures Made'. So the itemized layer STARTS ON PAGE 2, not page 3. The table columns are Date / Contributor Name / Occupation / Employer / Type / Amount / In-Kind? - there is NO mailing-address column at all, so donor_city/donor_state are blank by ABSENCE OF THE FIELD (the cover's address and phone blocks ARE redacted with black bars, but no donor address was ever printed). The In-Kind? column is empty on every one of the 140 rows, so in_kind=false throughout. Contributor names are printed 'Last, First' EXCEPT for a handful printed first-last ('Mark Crockett', 'Diana J. Peterson', 'O'Hara Randy') - kept verbatim. Four contributions are the candidate's own (Mark Crockett, $3,000 + $8,000 + $10,000 + $10,000) and two expenditures repay him. The last three expenditures carry the word 'AMENDMENT' under the date in the date cell and are contribution refunds - this document is the AMENDED September 15, 2012 interim report, as the cover states. p5 also prints 'No Contributions Received from other Campaign Accounts reported for this period.' and 'No Expenditures of other Campaign Accounts reported for this period.' - honest zeros on that separate track. GEOMETRY IS OMITTED on every row of this filing: the printout's rows are variable height (1-3 text lines) and a uniform band estimate would point at the wrong row, so per the contract no pointer is given rather than a wrong one. Field-shift screen passed on both sides: on every page the number of names equals the number of amounts, every date cell holds a date, and no name-shaped content appears in a date cell.
